definitions.meaning: One who acts with (wicked) folly, wantonly

quotations.old_english: Warnige hé eác þ-bar; hé þurh geþafunge ne wurðe þǽra fleardera geféra

source_text: fleardere, es; m. One who acts with (wicked) folly, wantonly :-- Warnige hé eác þ-bar; hé þurh geþafunge ne wurðe þǽra fleardera geféra, Nap. 23. v. next word.
